changes.passive: Base HP heal reduced from 120 to 100. Additional heal per 2s reduced from 120 to 100. Table max level heals decreased from 240 to 200.
changes.skill1: Base damage reduced from 350 (+120% bonus AD) to 325 (+100% bonus AD). Table base damage reduced from 350~700 to 325~650. Mark damage description clarified to 'Max HP' instead of 'HP'.
changes.skill2: Base damage reduced from 150 to 145. Level scaling reduced from 30/lv to 18/lv. Table base damage reduced from 150~300 to 145~235.
changes.skill3: Description clarified to deal damage based on 'Max HP' rather than 'HP'.

changes.passive: Completely reworked. Now grants damage reduction based on HP thresholds (70-100% HP: 5% reduction, 40-70% HP: 10% reduction, 0-40% HP: 20% reduction). Excess healing is converted into a permanent shield.
changes.skill1: Dash damage increased from 190 (+100% total AD) to 350 (+120% bonus AD). Enhanced basic attack damage increased from 65 (+15% total AD) to 120 (+40% bonus AD). Slow duration reduced from 2.5s to 2s. Dash distance now scales with skill level (+0 to +100). Table base damage increased from 250~500 to 350~700. Now gains 1 stack of S1 on passive phase change.
changes.skill2: Changed from 4 thrusts to 5 thrusts. Damage per thrust increased from 120 (+48% total AD) to 200 (+65% bonus AD). Heal changed from 25 (+12% total AD) to 65 (+2.5% bonus HP). Added diminishing returns (each subsequent hit reduces damage/heal by 8%). Phase passive effects removed from S2.
changes.skill3: Base damage increased from 350 (+130% total AD) / table 400~800 to 550 (+150% bonus AD) / table 550~1100. Cooldown reduced from 35~25s to 18~15s. Added Shock effect (subsequent skill hits on target deal additional magic damage). Added 50% CD refund if no hero is hit. Phase passive state change removed.

changes.passive: Sub-attribute base damage increased from 49 to 57. Scaling changed from +30% total AD to +35%~70% (scaling with level).
changes.skill1: Cooldown increased from 12~9.6s to 12.5~10s. Base physical damage reduced from 300 (+60% bonus AD) to 270 (+70% bonus AD). Base true damage reduced from 75 (+15% bonus AD) to 70 (+16% bonus AD). Enhanced basic attack base true damage reduced from 54 to 48. Added note that skill cast speed scales with attack speed.
changes.skill2: Cooldown increased from 12~9.6s to 12.5~10s. Base physical damage reduced from 240 (+35% bonus AD) to 180 (+45% bonus AD). Enhanced basic attack base damage reduced from 54 to 48. Non-hero unit heal penalty unified to a flat 50% reduction. Added note that skill cast speed scales with attack speed.
changes.skill3: Cooldown increased from 12~9.6s to 12.5~10s. Base physical damage reduced from 240 (+35% bonus AD) to 180 (+45% bonus AD). Enhanced basic attack base damage reduced from 54 to 48. Added note that skill cast speed scales with attack speed.
changes.skill4: Attack range buff reduced from 50 to 25. Text simplified to state it attacks up to 2 additional targets (removed mention of two attributes). Added note that flight speed scales with ultimate level.
